name: browser-use
headline: Agents-Skill: Generate AGENTS.md with Ease
short_description: Generates and maintains AGENTS.md files following the agents.md specification for AI coding agents across Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and compatible platforms.
author: netresearch

sections.overview:
This skill automates the creation and maintenance of AGENTS.md files, a Markdown convention adopted by 60,000+ open-source projects to guide AI coding agents. It supports Go, PHP, TypeScript, Python, and hybrid projects, automatically extracting commands from Makefile, package.json, composer.json, and go.mod. The skill creates thin root files with precedence rules and automatically detects subsystems to generate scoped documentation files. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other Agent Skills-compatible platforms, making it easier for teams to onboard AI agents into their development workflows.
Generate AGENTS.md documentation for new open-source projects
Update agent context files when project structure changes
Create scoped AGENTS.md files for multi-language backend/frontend projects
Maintain consistent AI agent onboarding across team repositories
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/netresearch/agents-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Generate an AGENTS.md file for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include at least 5 agents with their roles, responsibilities, and any relevant details. Follow the agents.md convention and ensure it's compatible with Claude Code.
```
Copy
